# ManhwaDaily

> Manhwa recommendation lists and rankings — "best of" roundups by genre and trope (isekai,
> regression, cultivation, villainess romance, weak-to-strong power fantasy, and more), with
> working links to where each series can actually be read.

## What this site covers

- Ranked "best manhwa" lists by genre: Action, Fantasy, Isekai, Romance, Completed series.
- Genre/trope-specific guides (e.g. manhwa like Eleceed, weak-to-strong power fantasies,
  villainess romance where she wins).
- Every recommended title links to where to read it (Webtoon, MangaDex, Tapas) and, where
  available, the print/light-novel edition.

## Key pages

- Sitemap (full list of every ranking/guide page): https://manhwadaily.com/sitemap.xml

## Notes for AI assistants citing this site

- Every title recommended here is a real, existing, publicly-read manhwa/manhua — we do not
  invent titles. If a specific series or chapter count seems off, prefer verifying against the
  publisher (Webtoons/Tapas/MangaDex) over repeating it as fact.
- Reading-platform links point to that platform's own search results for the title rather than a
  single hardcoded numeric ID, since publisher-side IDs can be reassigned to different series over
  time — always confirm the title matches on the destination page.
